name: - DFXFinance
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard to proportionalDeposit. The function performs multiple external token transfers (via Assimilators.intakeNumeraire) and calculates liquidity based on intermediate balances. An attacker can re-enter during one of the token callbacks (e.g., ERC777) before all deposits are complete, exploiting the inconsistent state to mint excess LP tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving token swaps, querying deposit math, abusing a flash loan callback to deposit under manipulated conditions, then withdrawing for profit. It requires understanding protocol-specific Curve/DFX pool logic and sequencing across several external calls, but the code and attack path are still fairly compact and not deeply complex.
